scope: Same-dataset tone baseline and candidate comparison
validated_behaviors: Baseline and candidate are independently revalidated from exact prediction runs.
Dataset, split, denominator, class support and slice support must match.
Absolute macro F1, unknown recall and coverage are reported with deltas.
Per-class recall and per-slice macro F1 regressions are reported.
Any comparable regression greater than two percentage points requires explicit review.
Synthetic or otherwise non-publishable gold cannot produce an eligible comparison.
known_boundary: This unit compares frozen outputs; it does not run models, calibrate confidence, approve cost or latency, or admit production publication.
